note: v0, written zero-shot. score = -cost + beta * min(pot_time, pot_cap). A label that is a bit more expensive but early in the day and lightly loaded can still collect duals; the cheapest-only rule throws it away. The min is the bottleneck resource (time or capacity), built exactly from ReLUs: min(a,b) = a - relu(a-b). cost is split into relu(c) and relu(-c) to pass through the ReLU layer. beta = 0.5: only part of the optimistic potential is realizable.
